summary.headline: Inceptions and Astrological Judgments
summary.text: Catalog of astrological consultation chapters in the twelve-place system of inceptions, covering lost things, judgments, runaways, thieves, friends or enemies, pregnancy, success, illness, hermaphroditic barrenness, mortality, malefics, trigonal lords, and non-nourishing degrees, with cross-references to Vatican, Venetian, Viennese, Parisian, and Italian codices and to Palchus.
